import re
p='config/service.toml'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()

sec=None
vals={}

    t=line.strip()
    if not t: continue
    m=re.fullmatch(r'\[([^\]]+)\]', t)
    if m:

print("PARSED:", vals)
